Synopsis:
    UK PM Andy Burnham faces mounting fiscal pressure as parliament resumes. Key challenges include funding social care reform, filling a £4.7B defence gap, managing illegal immigration, early prisoner releases, and a contentious October 28 budget. Finance minister Healey is expected to use fiscal rule "flexibility" — implying more borrowing and potential tax rises — while honouring day-to-day spending balance commitments. Burnham enters this phase with political capital but risks rapid popularity erosion.
